I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: "Thanks Marcus, noted: the signed order form for Brackenwater Freight Co. is due 26 November."

He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. His message in the channel is the record of the deadline. The workspace's knowledge base saves channel messages as they happen, so the date is kept there too. A deadline isn't a finance figure, so posting it in the channel is fine.
